page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.24xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.7 GHz, delivering 96 dedicated vCPUs. The server is paired with 192.0 GB of memory, reflecting a classic compute-focused 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. It operates without dedicated hardware accelerators, featuring zero GPUs.

Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 50 Gbps, enabling substantial throughput for network-heavy data movement. Storage configuration requires remote block storage, as the instance includes no bundled local disk storage. Similarly, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned directly with the base configuration.

Due to its high dedicated core count and standard 1:2 memory ratio, the instance is targeted at workloads prioritizing raw parallel CPU throughput over per-core memory footprint. The 50 Gbps network interface offsets local storage limitations by facilitating low-latency communication with external cloud storage volumes and distributed nodes. Best-fit use cases include compute-heavy parallel workloads, batch data processing, continuous integration build servers, and high-throughput network applications.

With high CPU concurrency and substantial network capacity, this instance is suited for compute-intensive batch processing, video rendering, compilation pipelines, and distributed analytical engines.
